homeFaq.title: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
homeFaq.subtitle: Learn more about our methodology, data sources, and guidance approach.
homeFaq.q1: How does OrienX recommend majors without just guessing?
homeFaq.a1: OrienX combines 4 distinct data points: your original MBTI-inspired personality preferences, your RIASEC Holland interest codes, your strongest school subjects (e.g. Mathematics, Physics, English), and your practical budget constraints. Every recommendation comes with an explainable match breakdown showing exactly why the major fits your profile.
homeFaq.q2: Is the university tuition information accurate and verified?
homeFaq.a2: Yes. We source institutional pricing directly from verified university admissions portals and partner sources like Sala.co. Where fees vary or are unconfirmed, we clearly label them as 'Information not available' or 'Tuition pending verification' rather than inventing data.
homeFaq.q3: Can I take the assessment again if my interests change?
homeFaq.a3: Absolutely. Students can retake both the Personality Assessment and RIASEC Career Interest test at any time from their dashboard. Your recommendations will instantly update based on your latest responses.
homeFaq.q4: Is OrienX free for Cambodian students?
homeFaq.a4: Yes, taking assessments, exploring university directories, comparing programs, and receiving personalized major recommendations is 100% free for students.

homeTestimonials.eyebrow: SEE WHAT OUR STUDENTS HAVE TO SAY
homeTestimonials.title: Empowering Cambodian Students
homeTestimonials.subtitle: Real feedback from students who discovered their university direction with OrienX.
homeTestimonials.t1: After Grade 12 exams, I was torn between IT and Civil Engineering. OrienX's RIASEC assessment clearly broke down my analytical strengths. I'm now confidently studying Software Engineering at ITC.
homeTestimonials.t2: What I loved most is the real verified tuition fees. I was able to compare NUM and Paragon side-by-side and discovered a merit scholarship that fits my family's budget perfectly.
homeTestimonials.t3: The personality test didn't just give 4 letters — it explained my learning style and the exact work environments where I can thrive. A must-have for all Grade 12 students!
homeTestimonials.t4: I was overwhelmed by so many university options. OrienX helped me filter by tuition budget and location, showing me exact scholarships I qualified for.
homeTestimonials.t5: The major comparison tool showed me the career outcomes and salaries in Cambodia for Data Science vs Cybersecurity. Made my decision 10x easier!
